mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect overcast skies around Reddan Soccer Park with temperatures at 57 degrees, feeling like 52 degrees. An elevated air quality alert is also in effect with an index of 54.

As winter approaches, the city reminds residents that alternate-side street parking takes effect November 20 through April 1 to keep roads clear for snow removal. Additionally, the Verona Water Utility is partnering with HydroCorp to conduct residential and commercial cross-connection control inspections to ensure a clean public water supply.

You can stretch and unwind with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Tomorrow, test your knowledge at local trivia nights hosted at Hop Haus Brewing Company, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Macs. Looking ahead to the weekend, live music kicks off at Baileys Run Vineyard on Friday.

In this weeks police recap, officers responded to Ashton Drive on Thursday after observing two 13-year-olds riding prohibited e-motos. Because the youth had been previously warned, both parents were cited for permitting a minor to operate the vehicle.
Culvers is open today until 10:00 PM, featuring Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie as the flavor of the day. Tomorrow, look out for Turtle Cheesecake.
